title: Approximate tangential differentiability of f along M with gradient G, from C¹ chart pieces (Simon Ch. 3, 2.1; Remark 1.8(1))
statement: Let P, d ∈ ℕ, let M ⊆ ℝ^P be Borel with H^d(M ∩ K) < ∞ for every compact K (H^d = μHE[d]), and let f : ℝ^P → ℝ and G : ℝ^P → ℝ^P be arbitrary maps. For j ∈ ℕ let ψ_j : ℝ^d → ℝ^P and F_j : ℝ^d → ℝ be C¹ and V_j, Y_j ⊆ ℝ^d, such that ψ_j is injective on V_j, Dψ_j(y) is injective for y ∈ V_j, closure(Y_j) is compact and contained in V_j, ψ_j(Y_j) is Borel and contained in M, and for every y ∈ Y_j: f(ψ_j(y)) = F_j(y); M has approximate tangent space Dψ_j(y)(ℝ^d) at ψ_j(y) (Simon Ch. 3, 1.4); G(ψ_j(y)) ∈ Dψ_j(y)(ℝ^d); and ⟨G(ψ_j(y)), Dψ_j(y)e⟩ = DF_j(y)e for all e ∈ ℝ^d. Assume H^d(M ∖ ⋃_j ψ_j(Y_j)) = 0. Then for H^d-a.e. x ∈ M: M has approximate tangent space T_xM := approxTangentPlane d M x at x, G(x) ∈ T_xM, and for every ε > 0, H^d({y ∈ M ∩ B_r(x) : ε|y − x| < |f(y) − f(x) − ⟨G(x), y − x⟩|})/r^d → 0 as r ↓ 0 (B_r(x) = ball x r; quotient in [0, ∞] with r^d entered as ENNReal.ofReal (r ^ d)).
